verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers uptime monitoring, incident management, status pages, and AI SRE features but contains no documentation about data retention policies, configurable retention periods, or data deletion controls for logs/metrics/telemetry data. No mention of GDPR/data deletion tooling, retention settings, or export/delete APIs specific to user data. missing for 10: retention period configuration, data deletion/export controls, documentation on how long logs/metrics/traces are stored or how to purge them.
